descriptions.fr:
ELCO propose des solutions de chauffage haut de gamme avec un service de première classe conçu pour répondre aux souhaits de nos clients tout au long du cycle de vie des produits et des systèmes de chauffage. L'accent est mis sur l'excellent conseil ainsi que sur les produits convaincants et les systèmes de chauffage. ELCO est un leader en matière de brûleurs, de condensation et de technologie solaire depuis des décennies et est représenté dans toute l'Europe avec 1,7 million de systèmes de chauffage installés. Depuis 1928, ELCO est une marque européenne de premier plan offrant des solutions et des technologies intelligentes adaptées aux besoins des projets privés et commerciaux, assurant ainsi des économies d'énergie maximales. Afin de renforcer notre groupe de services dans le domaine du gaz, nous recherchons une personnalité fiable et indépendante pour la zone d'application Gerlafingen - Soltothurn. Mécanicien des services gaz (m/w) Avec nous il y a de nombreuses tâches passionnantes pour vous
• Mise en service des systèmes de chauffage au gaz
• Commandes d'entretien et de gestion dans la zone de service assignée
• Résoudre les dysfonctionnements et les problèmes de chauffage au gaz
• Conseiller les clients sur le cadre optimal des installations supervisées
• Collaboration avec nos contacts tels que les installateurs, les ventes de service intérieur et extérieur et les employés de toute l'équipe de service Pour notre réussite commune, apportez avec vous
• Formation complète EFZ en tant qu'installateur de chauffage, installateur sanitaire ou installateur électrique, dans le secteur de l'automobile technique ou du génie électrique
• L'expérience de technicien de service est un avantage
• Quelques années d'expérience professionnelle et un haut niveau de responsabilité personnelle
• Préparation à l'éducation et à la formation sur diverses sources d'énergie
• Méthodes de travail structurées, exactes et efficaces
• Traitement correct et amical des clients internes et externes
• Préparation pour Pikettdienst, grande indépendance dans la planification du travail
• Lieu de résidence dans la zone d'exploitation ou adjacent Ce qui nous rend uniques
• Environnement de travail dynamique avec ambiance familiale et esprit d'équipe
• Véhicule de service à usage privé et équipement avec technologie moderne comme smartphone et tablette
• Produits modernes et orientés vers l'avenir dans le secteur premium
• Possibilités de perfectionnement professionnel
• Commencez comme une carrière chez ELCO et développez personnellement et professionnellement Postulez maintenant et devenez membre de notre famille ELCO. Ensemble, nous façonnons l'avenir. Notre équipe RH répond aux questions concernant notre travail ou le processus de candidature. descriptions.it:
Ariston Group is a global leader in sustainable thermal comfort that offers a unique, extensive range of solutions for climate comfort, water heating and air handling, as well as components and burners. Listed on Euronext Milan since November 2021, in 2024 the group reported over 2.6-billion-euro revenues, with over 10,000 employees, direct presence in 40 countries in 5 continents, 28 production sites and 28 research and development centers. The group demonstrates its commitment to sustainability through the development of renewable and high efficiency solutions, such as heat pumps, water heating heat pumps, hybrids, domestic ventilation, air handling and solar thermal systems. The group also stands out for its continuous investment in technological innovation, digitalization, and advanced connectivity solutions. The group operates under global strategic brands Ariston, Elco and Wolf, and brands such as Calorex, NTI, HTP, Atag, Brink, Chromagen, Racold, as well as Thermowatt and Ecoflam in the components and burners business.

Ariston Group is a global leader in sustainable comfort solutions, currently accelerating its digital transformation journey through advanced data, cloud, and AI-driven platforms. Within this growth context, the AI & Agentic Solutions Engineer plays a key role in enabling the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across the organization, shaping scalable AI solutions and supporting the evolution of business processes through agentic and Copilot-based technologies.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Design, develop, and evolve AI and Generative AI solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Microsoft Copilot, and agent-based architectures.
- Build and customize AI agents using Copilot Studio and custom agent implementations based on MCP/A2A protocols.
- Develop AI services and agents in Python or Java, ensuring code quality, security, and maintainability.
- Design and implement cloud-native AI architectures deployed on Kubernetes and integrated with enterprise systems via APIs and microservices.
- Configure, extend, and govern Microsoft Copilot solutions in enterprise environments.
- Evaluate and integrate different LLM providers and models according to business, security, and compliance requirements.
- Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to identify AI use cases, collect and refine requirements, and translate business needs into technical solutions.
- Act as a bridge between business and technology, ensuring alignment between value expectations and technical delivery.
- Support the planning and execution of AI projects, including activity prioritization, coordination with internal teams and partners, and monitoring progress, risks, and dependencies.
- Contribute to the definition and evolution of AI roadmaps, standards, and architectural patterns within the AI Chapter.
- Promote AI adoption across the organization through best practices, guidelines, and responsible AI usage models.
- Contribute to organizational evolution by fostering an AI-driven culture and supporting internal capability growth.

QUALIFICATIONS

- Proven experience in Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI solutions.
- Strong knowledge of LLMs, agentic architectures, and AI orchestration patterns.
- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio.
- Experience in building custom AI agents using MCP/A2A protocols.
- Solid programming skills in Python and/or Java.
- Experience with containerized environments and Kubernetes-based architectures.
- Familiarity with microservices, API-first architectures, and enterprise integrations.
- Understanding of AI security, governance, and compliance principles (privacy, data handling, logging).
- Experience working in Agile or Hybrid Agile delivery models.
- Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Business-oriented mindset with a strong focus on value creation and problem solving.
- Proactive, collaborative attitude and ability to manage complexity across multiple initiatives.

WHAT YOU SHOULD BRING ALONG?

- University degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics, Physics or comparable field
- Few years of practical experience in software development with Python (e.g., through internships, working student positions or thesis projects)
- Good written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams (knowledge of Italian and/or German is a plus)

NICE TO HAVE

- Some experience in large enterprise environments and complex digital ecosystems.
- Knowledge of cloud hyperscalers, with preference for Microsoft Azure and Amazon AWS.
- Some years of experience in implementing and industrializing AI solutions
- Background in system integration and digital platforms.
- Experience contributing to standards definition, architectural governance, or chapter-based organizations.

The compensation package will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills and the scope of the role, applying objective and gender neutral criteria. We believe that transparency and fairness are essential to building trust, fostering inclusion and ensuring equal opportunities for everyone.

As a reference, for this position we offer a salary starting from €50,000 and above, depending on experience. This position is covered by the CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria

Location: Milan, Fabriano (AN), Mainburg (Germany)

We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all people. We strive to provide a work environment that is accessible, welcoming and inclusive, in full compliance with applicable legal requirements. In line with this commitment, we promote fair, transparent and equitable reward practices. The compensation package will be determined based on experience, skills and the scope of the role, applying objective and gender‑neutral criteria. We believe that transparency and fairness are essential to building trust, fostering inclusion and ensuring equal opportunities for everyone.

descriptions.it: Ariston Group è leader globale nel comfort termico sostenibile che offre una vasta gamma di soluzioni per il comfort climatico, il riscaldamento e la gestione dell'aria, nonché componenti e bruciatori. Elencato su Euronext Milano dal novembre 2021, nel 2024 il gruppo ha riportato oltre 2,6 miliardi di euro di ricavi, con oltre 10.000 dipendenti, presenza diretta in 40 paesi in 5 continenti, 28 siti produttivi e 28 centri di ricerca e sviluppo. Il gruppo dimostra il suo impegno per la sostenibilità attraverso lo sviluppo di soluzioni rinnovabili e ad alta efficienza, come pompe di calore, pompe di calore per il riscaldamento dell'acqua, ibridi, ventilazione domestica, gestione dell'aria e sistemi termici solari. Il gruppo si distingue anche per il suo continuo investimento in innovazione tecnologica, digitalizzazione e soluzioni di connettività avanzate. Il gruppo opera sotto marchi strategici globali Ariston, Elco e Wolf, e marchi come Calorex, NTI, HTP, Atag, Brink, Chromagen, Racold, così come Thermowatt ed Ecoflam nel settore componenti e bruciatori. Siamo alla ricerca di un Project Sales Manager per i risultati per condurre sia la crescita delle vendite del progetto che le prestazioni di Ariston eStore . Questo ruolo combina una forte capacità di vendita del progetto B2B con un crescente focus sulle vendite digitali dirette a consumo (D2C), che richiedono sia l'acume commerciale che l'esecuzione pratica. Il candidato ideale guiderà attivamente le opportunità di progetto attraverso gli sviluppi residenziali e commerciali, ottimizzando anche le prestazioni di vendita online per accelerare la crescita dei ricavi. Principali responsabilità - Promuovere la crescita delle vendite del progetto identificando, sviluppando e convertendo opportunità attraverso gli sviluppi residenziali e commerciali - Costruire relazioni forti con sviluppatori, principali appaltatori, architetti e consulenti M&E per garantire specifiche e vincite di progetto - Impegnarsi presto nelle fasi di pianificazione del progetto per influenzare l'inclusione del prodotto e massimizzare i tassi di vincita - Lead end-to-end offerte, tra cui strategia dei prezzi, conformità tecnica e coordinamento interno - Preparare proposte competitive e di alta qualità allineate ai requisiti dei clienti e agli obiettivi aziendali - Proprio e guidare le prestazioni eStore di Ariston, concentrandosi sulla crescita dei ricavi e la redditività - Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie di prezzi, campagne digitali e ottimizzazione mix di prodotti - Identificare le opportunità per espandere i canali di vendita D2C - Migliorare i tassi di conversione attraverso efficaci strategie di posizionamento dei prodotti, promozioni e risposta dei clienti - Garantire un viaggio clienti senza soluzione di continuità dalla richiesta attraverso l'acquisto all'installazione - Costruire e mantenere relazioni forti con sviluppatori, consulenti, appaltatori e distributori - Crescere account chiave e guidare le opportunità di business ripeti - Posizione Ariston come marchio preferito per le soluzioni di riscaldamento ad acqua - Collaborare con i team tecnici per fornire soluzioni adeguate per il riscaldamento dell'acqua (ad esempio, riscaldatori elettrici, riscaldatori istantanei, sistemi centralizzati) - Assicurare la conformità alle specifiche del progetto, agli standard normativi e alle esigenze del cliente - Monitorare le tendenze del mercato, le attività dei concorrenti e i prossimi progetti - Sviluppare proposizioni di valore convincenti che sottolineano i punti di forza di Ariston come l'efficienza energetica, l'affidabilità e la tecnologia Wi-Fi intelligente - Lavorare a stretto contatto con le operazioni, la logistica e i team di assistenza post-vendita per garantire la consegna di progetti fluidi - Supporta i processi di installazione e messa in servizio mantenendo alta soddisfazione del cliente - Gestire i tassi di conversione del canale di vendita e traccia utilizzando strumenti CRM - Fornire previsioni, report e approfondimenti regolari alla gestione Esperienza chiave e qualifiche - Laurea (o Diploma) in Business, Ingegneria, Servizi edili, o campo relativo - 5-8 anni di esperienza nelle vendite di progetti, preferibilmente nel riscaldamento dell'acqua, HVAC, sanitari o industrie correlate - Provato record di traccia nel garantire e fornire le vendite di progetto B2B - Forte comprensione dell'ecosistema di costruzione di Singapore, comprese le offerte, le specifiche e le normative - Esperienza di lavoro con sviluppatori, consulenti M&E e appaltatori preferiti - Familiarità con sistemi CRM e gestione delle tubazioni Siamo impegnati nel principio della parità di opportunità di lavoro per tutte le persone, offrendo un ambiente di lavoro accessibile, accogliente e inclusivo nel rispetto degli obblighi legali.

The group operates under global strategic brands Ariston, Elco and Wolf, and brands such as Calorex, NTI, HTP, Atag, Brink, Chromagen, Racold, as well as Thermowatt and Ecoflam in the components and burners business. We are looking for a results-driven Project Sales Manager to lead both project sales growth and Ariston’s eStore performance . This role combines strong B2B project sales capability with a growing focus on direct-to-consumer (D2C) digital sales , requiring both commercial acumen and hands-on execution. The ideal candidate will actively drive project opportunities across residential and commercial developments while also optimizing online sales performance to accelerate revenue growth. Key Responsibilities - Drive project sales growth by identifying, developing, and converting opportunities across residential and commercial developments - Build strong relationships with developers, main contractors, architects, and M&E consultants to secure specifications and project wins - Engage early in project planning stages to influence product inclusion and maximize win rates - Lead end-to-end tender submissions, including pricing strategy, technical compliance, and internal coordination - Prepare competitive and high-quality proposals aligned with client requirements and company objectives - Own and drive Ariston’s eStore performance, focusing on revenue growth and profitability - Develop and execute pricing strategies, digital campaigns, and product mix optimization - Identify opportunities to expand D2C sales channels - Improve conversion rates through effective product positioning, promotions, and customer response strategies - Ensure a seamless customer journey from enquiry through purchase to installation - Build and maintain strong relationships with developers, consultants, contractors, and distributors - Grow key accounts and drive repeat business opportunities - Position Ariston as a preferred brand for water heating solutions - Collaborate with technical teams to deliver suitable water heating solutions (e.g., electric storage heaters, instant heaters, centralized systems) - Ensure compliance with project specifications, regulatory standards, and client needs - Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and upcoming projects - Develop compelling value propositions emphasizing Ariston’s strengths such as energy efficiency, reliability, and smart Wi-Fi technology - Work closely with operations, logistics, and after-sales teams to ensure smooth project delivery - Support installation and commissioning processes while maintaining high customer satisfaction - Manage sales pipeline and track conversion rates using CRM tools - Proven track record in securing and delivering B2B project sales - Strong understanding of the Singapore construction ecosystem, including tenders, specifications, and regulations - Experience working with developers, M&E consultants, and contractors preferred - Familiarity with CRM systems and pipeline management We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all people, by offering a work environment accessible, welcoming and inclusive in compliance with legal obligations.
descriptions.de: Ariston Group ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von nachhaltigem thermischem Komfort, der eine einzigartige, umfangreiche Palette von Lösungen für Klimakomfort, Warmwasserbereitung und Luftbehandlung sowie Komponenten und Brenner bietet. Seit November 2021 an der Euronext Mailand notiert, erzielte die Gruppe 2024 einen Umsatz von über 2,6 Milliarden Euro mit über 10.000 Mitarbeitern, direkter Präsenz in 40 Ländern auf 5 Kontinenten, 28 Produktionsstätten und 28 Forschungs- und Entwicklungszentren. Die Gruppe zeigt ihr Engagement für Nachhaltigkeit durch die Entwicklung erneuerbarer und hocheffizienter Lösungen wie Wärmepumpen, Warmwasserbereitungswärmepumpen, Hybriden, Haushaltslüftung, Luftbehandlung und Solarthermie. Die Gruppe zeichnet sich auch durch kontinuierliche Investitionen in technologische Innovationen, Digitalisierung und fortschrittliche Konnektivitätslösungen aus. Die Gruppe ist unter den globalen strategischen Marken Ariston, Elco und Wolf sowie Marken wie Calorex, NTI, HTP, Atag, Brink, Chromagen, Racold sowie Thermowatt und Ecoflam im Komponenten- und Brennergeschäft tätig. Wir suchen einen ergebnisorientierten Project Sales Manager, der sowohl das Projektumsatzwachstum als auch die eStore-Performance von Ariston leitet. Diese Rolle verbindet eine starke B2B-Projektvertriebsfähigkeit mit einem wachsenden Fokus auf digitalen Direct-to-Consumer (D2C)-Vertrieb, der sowohl kommerziellen Scharfsinn als auch praktische Ausführung erfordert. Der ideale Kandidat wird die Projektchancen für Wohn- und Geschäftsentwicklungen aktiv vorantreiben und gleichzeitig die Online-Vertriebsleistung optimieren, um das Umsatzwachstum zu beschleunigen. Hauptzuständigkeiten - Steigerung des Projektumsatzes durch Identifizierung, Entwicklung und Umwandlung von Möglichkeiten für Wohn- und Geschäftsentwicklungen - Aufbau starker Beziehungen zu Entwicklern, Hauptauftragnehmern, Architekten und M & E-Beratern, um Spezifikationen und Projektgewinne zu sichern - Engagieren Sie sich frühzeitig in der Projektplanung, um die Produktinklusion zu beeinflussen und die Gewinnraten zu maximieren - Führen Sie End-to-End-Tendereinreichungen, einschließlich Preisstrategie, technischer Compliance und interner Koordination - Bereiten Sie wettbewerbsfähige und qualitativ hochwertige Vorschläge vor, die auf die Kundenanforderungen und Unternehmensziele ausgerichtet sind - Eigene und treibende Leistung von Ariston eStore mit Fokus auf Umsatzwachstum und Rentabilität - Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Preisstrategien, digitalen Kampagnen und Produktmixoptimierung - Chancen identifizieren, D2C-Vertriebskanäle zu erweitern - Verbessern Sie die Conversion-Rate durch effektive Produktpositionierung, Promotions und Kundenreaktionsstrategien - Sicherstellen einer nahtlosen Customer Journey von der Anfrage über den Kauf bis zur Installation - Aufbau und Pflege starker Beziehungen zu Entwicklern, Beratern, Auftragnehmern und Distributoren - Steigern Sie Key Accounts und fördern Sie wiederholte Geschäftsmöglichkeiten - Positionieren Sie Ariston als bevorzugte Marke für Wasserheizungslösungen - Arbeiten Sie mit technischen Teams zusammen, um geeignete Warmwasserbereitungslösungen zu liefern (z. B. elektrische Speicherheizungen, Sofortheizgeräte, zentrale Systeme) - Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Projektspezifikationen, Regulierungsstandards und Kundenanforderungen - Überwachen Sie Markttrends, Wettbewerberaktivitäten und bevorstehende Projekte - Entwickeln Sie überzeugende Wertversprechen, die Aristons Stärken wie Energieeffizienz, Zuverlässigkeit und intelligente Wi-Fi-Technologie betonen - Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Operations, Logistik und After-Sales-Teams, um eine reibungslose Projektabwicklung zu gewährleisten - Unterstützung von Installations- und Inbetriebnahmeprozessen bei gleichzeitig hoher Kundenzufriedenheit - Verwalten Sie die Vertriebspipeline und verfolgen Sie die Konversionsraten mit CRM-Tools - Bereitstellung regelmäßiger Prognosen, Berichte und Erkenntnisse für das Management Key Experience & Qualifikationen - Bachelor-Abschluss (oder Diplom) in Business, Engineering, Building Services oder verwandten Bereichen - 5-8 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektverkauf, vorzugsweise in der Warmwasserbereitung, HVAC, Sanitär oder verwandten Industrien - Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Sicherung und Lieferung von B2B-Projektverkäufen - Starkes Verständnis des Bauökosystems von Singapur, einschließlich Ausschreibungen, Spezifikationen und Vorschriften - Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklern, M & E-Beratern und bevorzugten Auftragnehmern - Vertrautheit mit CRM-Systemen und Pipelinemanagement Wir sind dem Grundsatz der gleichen Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten für alle Menschen verpflichtet, indem wir in Übereinstimmung mit den gesetzlichen Verpflichtungen ein zugängliches, einladendes und integratives Arbeitsumfeld bieten.
descriptions.fr: Ariston Group est un leader mondial dans le confort thermique durable qui offre une gamme unique et étendue de solutions pour le confort climatique, le chauffage de l'eau et la manutention de l'air, ainsi que des composants et des brûleurs. Inscrit sur Euronext Milan depuis novembre 2021, en 2024 le groupe a enregistré plus de 2,6 milliards d'euros de revenus, avec plus de 10 000 employés, présence directe dans 40 pays sur 5 continents, 28 sites de production et 28 centres de recherche et développement. Le groupe démontre son engagement en faveur de la durabilité par le développement de solutions renouvelables et à haut rendement, telles que les pompes à chaleur, les pompes à chaleur pour le chauffage de l'eau, les hybrides, la ventilation domestique, la manutention de l'air et les systèmes solaires thermiques. Le groupe se distingue également par son investissement continu dans l'innovation technologique, la numérisation et les solutions de connectivité avancées. Le groupe opère sous les marques stratégiques mondiales Ariston, Elco et Wolf, et des marques telles que Calorex, NTI, HTP, Atag, Brink, Chromagen, Racold, ainsi que Thermowatt et Ecoflam dans le secteur des composants et brûleurs. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Project Sales Manager axé sur les résultats pour diriger à la fois la croissance des ventes de projets et les performances d'Ariston , eStore . Ce rôle combine une forte capacité de vente de projets B2B avec un accent croissant sur les ventes numériques directes au consommateur (D2C), nécessitant à la fois une acuité commerciale et une exécution pratique. Le candidat idéal pilotera activement les opportunités de projets à travers les développements résidentiels et commerciaux tout en optimisant la performance des ventes en ligne pour accélérer la croissance des revenus. Principales responsabilités - Favoriser la croissance des ventes de projets en identifiant, en développant et en convertissant les possibilités de développement résidentiel et commercial - Établir des relations solides avec les promoteurs, les principaux entrepreneurs, les architectes et les consultants en S et E pour obtenir des spécifications et des gains de projet - S'engager dès les premières étapes de la planification du projet pour influencer l'inclusion des produits et maximiser les taux de réussite - Diriger les soumissions de bout en bout, y compris la stratégie de tarification, la conformité technique et la coordination interne - Préparer des propositions compétitives et de haute qualité conformes aux exigences des clients et aux objectifs de l'entreprise - Les performances propres et dynamiques d'Aristote eStore, centrées sur la croissance des revenus et la rentabilité - Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies de tarification, des campagnes numériques et l'optimisation du mélange de produits - Identifier les possibilités d'élargir les canaux de vente D2C - Améliorer les taux de conversion grâce à des stratégies efficaces de positionnement des produits, de promotion et de réponse des clients - Assurer un parcours client sans faille de la demande à l'achat à l'installation - Établir et maintenir des relations solides avec les promoteurs, les consultants, les entrepreneurs et les distributeurs - Créer des comptes clés et générer des occasions d'affaires répétées - Position Ariston comme marque préférée pour les solutions de chauffage de l'eau - Collaborer avec des équipes techniques pour fournir des solutions de chauffage de l'eau appropriées (p. ex., chauffages électriques, chauffages instantanés, systèmes centralisés) - Assurer la conformité aux spécifications du projet, aux normes réglementaires et aux besoins des clients - Surveiller les tendances du marché, les activités des concurrents et les projets à venir - Élaborer des propositions de valeur convaincantes mettant l'accent sur les forces d'Ariston, comme l'efficacité énergétique, la fiabilité et la technologie Wi-Fi intelligente - Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes opérationnelles, logistiques et après-vente pour assurer la bonne exécution des projets - Prise en charge des processus d'installation et de mise en service tout en maintenant une grande satisfaction client - Gérer le pipeline de vente et suivre les taux de conversion à l'aide des outils CRM - Fournir régulièrement des prévisions, des rapports et des renseignements à la direction Expérience et qualifications clés - Baccalauréat (ou diplôme) en affaires, ingénierie, services de bâtiment, ou domaine connexe - 5 à 8 ans d'expérience dans la vente de projets, de préférence dans le chauffage de l'eau, la CVC, les industries sanitaires ou connexes - Expérience éprouvée dans la sécurisation et la livraison des ventes de projets B2B - Connaissance approfondie de l'écosystème de la construction de Singapour, y compris les appels d'offres, les spécifications et les règlements - Expérience de travail avec les promoteurs, les consultants en S et E et les entrepreneurs préférés - Connaissance des systèmes CRM et gestion des pipelines Nous sommes attachés au principe de l'égalité des chances en matière d'emploi pour tous, en offrant un environnement de travail accessible, accueillant et inclusif, conformément aux obligations légales.

descriptions.it:
ELCO è il principale fornitore di soluzioni di riscaldamento con un servizio di prima classe volto a soddisfare le esigenze dei consumatori lungo tutto il ciclo di vita dei suoi sistemi e prodotti. Consulenza, prodotti, sistemi e servizi di alta qualità. Per decenni, ELCO è stata all'avanguardia nella tecnologia dei bruciatori, nelle caldaie a condensazione e nell'energia solare, installando oltre 1,7 milioni di sistemi di riscaldamento in tutta Europa. Dal 1928, ELCO è un marchio leader a livello europeo che offre soluzioni e tecnologie intelligenti, progettate per soddisfare le esigenze di tutti i tipi di progetti domestici e commerciali, garantendo il massimo risparmio energetico.

Per potenziare il nostre team di servizio tecnico siamo alla ricerca di un: TECNICO DI SERVIZIO PER IMPIANTI DI RISCALDAMENTO A GAS - 100% Dopo una completa introduzione, sará responsabile dell'installazione, della manutenzione e della risoluzione dei problemi dei nostri prodotti. Mettiamo a disposizione un veicolo di servizio ben attrezzato e moderni strumenti tecnici. Le verrà assegnata la sua area di competenza e sará personalmente responsabile della gestione di tutti i guasti e le manutenzioni.

Requisiti:

- Formazione professionale conclusa (AFC) nel settore elettrico o meccanico (elettricista, polimeccanico)
- Preferibilmente conoscenze in elettrotecnica, tecnica idraulica, tecnica di regolazione e/o elettromeccanica
- Eccellenti abilità relazionali e propensione al lavoro di squadra
- Grande autonomia nella pianificazione del lavoro e flessibilità
- Disponibilità a turni di picchetto
- Residenza in Ticino, preferibilmente nel sottoceneri
- Conoscenze della lingua tedesca costituiscono un titolo preferenziale

Cosa offriamo:

- Veicolo di servizio anche ad uso privato
- Attività interessante e variata in un team giovane e dinamico
- Possibilità di sviluppo tecnico e supporto nella formazione
- Ottime prestazioni sociali

descriptions.it:
WOLF ist ein führender Anbieter nachhaltiger Wärmepumpen, Hybridlösungen und hocheffizienter Lüftungssysteme. WOLF unterstützt Planer, Installateure und Endkunden beim gesamten Auslegungsprozess und der Abstimmung der Komponenten von Heizsystemen und Lüftungsgeräten in den Bereichen Heizung, Solar, Klima und Lüftung und sorgt so für ein optimales Raumklima – für Einfamilienhäuser und Mehrfamilienhäuser bis hin zu Bürogebäuden und Industrieanlagen.

WOLF ist Teil der Ariston Group, ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen für nachhaltigen Wärmekomfort und bietet ein einzigartiges, umfassendes Lösungsangebot für Klimakomfort, Warmwasserbereitung und Luftaufbereitung sowie Komponenten und Brenner. Die seit November 2021 an der Euronext Mailand notierte Gruppe erzielte 2024 einen Umsatz von über 2,6 Milliarden Euro. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt über 10.000 Mitarbeiter, ist in 40 Ländern auf 5 Kontinenten vertreten und verfügt über 28 Produktionsstandorte sowie 28 Forschungs- und Entwicklungszentren. Die Gruppe unterstreicht ihr Engagement für Nachhaltigkeit durch die Entwicklung erneuerbarer und hocheffizienter Lösungen wie Wärmepumpen, Warmwasser-Wärmepumpen, Hybridsysteme, Wohnraumlüftung, Luftaufbereitung und Solarthermiesysteme. Die Gruppe zeichnet sich zudem durch kontinuierliche Investitionen in technologische Innovation, Digitalisierung und fortschrittliche Konnektivitätslösungen aus. Die Gruppe ist unter den globalen strategischen Marken Ariston, Elco und Wolf sowie im Komponenten- und Brennergeschäft unter Marken wie Calorex, NTI, HTP, Atag, Brink, Chromagen, Racold sowie Thermowatt und Ecoflam tätig.

Deine Aufgaben

- Technische und kaufmännische Unterstützung des Vertriebs bei Angebots- und Projektanfragen
- Erstellung, Prüfung und Nachverfolgung von Angeboten für gewerbliche Heizungsprojekte
- Technische Klärung von Kundenanforderungen in Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb und Produktmanagement
- Projektbezogene Koordination interner Schnittstellen (z. B. Technik, Service, Logistik)
- Pflege und Verwaltung von Angebots-, Projekt- und Kundendaten im CRM-System
- Unterstützung bei Ausschreibungen, Kalkulationen und Wirtschaftlichkeitsbetrachtungen
- Vorbereitung von Präsentationen, technischen Unterlagen und Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Kunden und interne Stakeholder

descriptions.it:
WOLF è un fornitore leader di pompe di calore sostenibili, soluzioni ibride e sistemi di ventilazione altamente efficienti. WOLF supporta progettisti, installatori e clienti finali in tutto il processo di progettazione e il coordinamento dei componenti dei sistemi di riscaldamento e delle unità di ventilazione nelle aree di riscaldamento, solare, aria condizionata e ventilazione e garantisce così un clima interno ottimale – per case monofamiliari e case multifamiliari fino a edifici per uffici e impianti industriali. WOLF fa parte del Gruppo Ariston, leader globale nel comfort termico sostenibile e offre una soluzione unica e completa per il comfort climatico, l'acqua calda e il trattamento dell'aria nonché componenti e bruciatori. Il gruppo, quotato su Euronext Milano dal novembre 2021, ha raggiunto un fatturato di oltre 2,6 miliardi di euro nel 2024. L'azienda impiega oltre 10.000 persone, è rappresentata in 40 paesi su 5 continenti e ha 28 siti produttivi e 28 centri di ricerca e sviluppo. Il Gruppo sottolinea il suo impegno per la sostenibilità sviluppando soluzioni rinnovabili e altamente efficienti come pompe di calore, pompe di calore ad acqua calda, sistemi ibridi, ventilazione residenziale, trattamento aria e sistemi termici solari. Il Gruppo si distingue anche per il continuo investimento in innovazione tecnologica, digitalizzazione e soluzioni avanzate di connettività. Il Gruppo opera sotto i marchi strategici globali Ariston, Elco e Wolf, nonché nei componenti e nelle attività di bruciatore sotto marchi come Calorex, NTI, HTP, Atag, Brink, Chromagen, Racold e Thermowatt ed Ecoflam. Le tue attività
• Consulenza e risoluzione dei problemi per i nostri prodotti di riscaldamento
• Avvio delle necessarie misure di follow-up
• Documentazione tecnica
• Registrazione delle operazioni di servizio e degli ordini dei pezzi di ricambio
• Assicurare il servizio di prontezza del fine settimana il tuo profilo
• Completo di formazione professionale tecnica o di qualificazione comparabile – anche come parte laterale di un settore comparabile (ad esempio campo di meccatronica, elettrico, elettrodomestici o simili), idealmente con ulteriore formazione come maestro / tecnico HLK
• Formazione o conoscenze specialistiche elettriche
• Idealmente, servizio clienti e/o esperienza di installazione
• Assoluto orientamento del cliente, ottime capacità di comunicazione e una rapida comprensione e capacità di conflitto
• Competenze informatiche sono desiderabili Le vostre prospettive
• Eccellente induzione, formazione regolare e ulteriori opportunità di sviluppo
• Opportunità di sviluppo in un'azienda a conduzione familiare con crescita continua in un'industria sostenibile e orientata al futuro
• Misure per conciliare lavoro e vita familiare, come modelli di tempo di lavoro flessibili e la capacità di lavorare mobile
• Cultura aziendale aperta e apprezzata e collaborazione collegiale su tutti i livelli gerarchici
• Un pagamento accattivante, relativo alle prestazioni per una vacanza annuale di 30 giorni, così come i soldi di vacanza e di Natale
• Grande libertà professionale in un ambiente di lavoro moderno con percorsi di comunicazione veloci
• Posto di lavoro nell'ufficio vendite Hannover, Dresda, Francoforte o Koblenz a seconda del luogo di residenza Il vostro contatto Iris Reitmeier iris.reitmeier@wolf.eu Ci impegniamo al principio della parità di opportunità di lavoro per tutte le persone fornendo un ambiente di lavoro accessibile, accogliente e inclusivo in conformità con gli obblighi legali.
descriptions.en:
WOLF is a leading provider of sustainable heat pumps, hybrid solutions and highly efficient ventilation systems. WOLF supports planners, installers and end customers in the entire design process and the coordination of the components of heating systems and ventilation units in the areas of heating, solar, air conditioning and ventilation and thus ensures an optimal indoor climate – for single-family houses and multi-family houses up to office buildings and industrial plants. WOLF is part of the Ariston Group, a global leader in sustainable thermal comfort and offers a unique, comprehensive solution for climate comfort, hot water and air treatment as well as components and burners. The group, which has been listed on Euronext Milan since November 2021, achieved a turnover of over 2.6 billion euros in 2024. The company employs over 10,000 people, is represented in 40 countries on 5 continents and has 28 production sites and 28 research and development centers. The Group underlines its commitment to sustainability by developing renewable and highly efficient solutions such as heat pumps, hot water heat pumps, hybrid systems, residential ventilation, air treatment and solar thermal systems. The Group also stands out for continuous investment in technological innovation, digitalisation and advanced connectivity solutions. The Group operates under the global strategic brands Ariston, Elco and Wolf as well as in the components and burner business under brands such as Calorex, NTI, HTP, Atag, Brink, Chromagen, Racold as well as Thermowatt and Ecoflam. Your activities
• Telephone customer advice and troubleshooting for our heating products
• Initiation of necessary follow-up measures
• Technical documentation
• Recording of service operations and spare parts orders
• Ensuring the weekend readiness service your profile
• Completed technical vocational training or comparable qualification – also as a lateral entrant from a comparable industry (e.g. field of mechatronics, electrics, household appliance technology or the like), ideally with further training as a master / technician HLK
• Electrical specialist training or knowledge
• Ideally, customer service and/or installation experience
• Absolute customer orientation, very good communication skills as well as a quick understanding and ability to conflict
• Computer skills are desirable Your perspectives
• Excellent induction, regular training and further development opportunities
• Development opportunities in a family-run company with continuous growth in a sustainable and future-oriented industry
• Measures to reconcile work and family life, such as flexible working time models and the ability to work mobile
• Open and appreciative corporate culture and collegial cooperation across all hierarchical levels
• An attractive, performance-related payment for an annual holiday of 30 days, as well as holiday and Christmas money
• Great professional freedom in a modern working environment with fast communication paths
• Workplace in the sales office Hannover, Dresden, Frankfurt or Koblenz depending on your place of residence Your contact Iris Reitmeier iris.reitmeier@wolf.eu We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunities for all people by providing an accessible, welcoming and inclusive working environment in accordance with legal obligations.

WOLF est un fournisseur leader de pompes à chaleur durables, de solutions hybrides et de systèmes de ventilation hautement efficaces. WOLF soutient les planificateurs, les installateurs et les clients finaux dans l'ensemble du processus de conception et la coordination des composants des systèmes de chauffage et des unités de ventilation dans les domaines du chauffage, de l'énergie solaire, de la climatisation et de la ventilation et assure ainsi un climat intérieur optimal – pour les maisons unifamiliales et les maisons multifamiliales jusqu'aux immeubles de bureaux et aux installations industrielles. WOLF fait partie du groupe Ariston, leader mondial du confort thermique durable et offre une solution unique et complète pour le confort climatique, l'eau chaude et le traitement de l'air ainsi que les composants et les brûleurs. Le groupe, coté sur Euronext Milan depuis novembre 2021, a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de plus de 2,6 milliards d'euros en 2024. L'entreprise emploie plus de 10 000 personnes, est représentée dans 40 pays sur 5 continents et compte 28 sites de production et 28 centres de recherche et développement. Le Groupe souligne son engagement en faveur de la durabilité en développant des solutions renouvelables et hautement efficaces telles que les pompes à chaleur, les pompes à chaleur à eau chaude, les systèmes hybrides, la ventilation résidentielle, le traitement de l'air et les systèmes solaires thermiques. descriptions.en:
ELCO is the leading provider of high-end heating solutions and a first-class service to meet the needs of consumers throughout the lifecycle of its systems and products. High quality advice, products, systems and services. For decades, ELCO has been at the forefront of burner, condensing boiler and solar energy technology, thanks to over 1.7 million heating systems installed throughout Europe. Since 1928, ELCO has been a leading European brand offering both smart solutions and technologies, designed to meet the needs of all types of domestic or commercial projects, guaranteeing maximum energy savings.

To strengthen our service team in the Geneva region, we are looking

GAS SERVICE TECHNICIAN

Your tasks – varied and responsible:

- Meeting the expectations of our customers both technically and through the maintenance of a quality customer relationship by contributing effectively to their satisfaction
- After a period of training and introduction, you will be responsible for the commissioning, maintenance and troubleshooting of facilities in the geographical area.
- Your professionalism and rigor will enable you to carry out your activities in full compliance with contractual commitments and rules relating to the safety of property and persons
- Ambassador of our company's image, you advise your customers, including on sanitation
- You are also a support to your colleagues in external sales as part of the sale of facilities
- You also periodically ensure the picket service

Your profile – technically competent, convincing personally:

- Attached to the quality of the service and endowed with an excellent customer relationship, you benefit from vocational training (with obtaining a CFC) in the field of electricity preference or other technical profession; a combustion controller training (ARPEA) or federal patent is an advantage
- Your team spirit, your commitment and your taste for the challenge are all the assets that will allow you to succeed in your job and evolve within our company

Our offer – your chance to help shape our service:

We offer you the opportunity to join a leading company in its field where customer experience represents every day an opportunity to make a difference to our customers. You will integrate a team of professionals and a pleasant working environment in which you will benefit from quality training on our heating solutions, a fully equipped service vehicle and modern working tools.

Ready for the next step in your career?

So we look forward to receiving your application online and soon getting to know you!

Please send your application exclusively online.

Files sent by e-mail or mail will not be considered.

We commit ourselves to respect the principle of equal access to employment for all persons, by providing an accessible, welcoming and inclusive working environment in accordance with legal obligations.
